advanced.note: Delay avoids flashing on fast loads; aspect ratio keeps media placeholders proportional without fixed heights; duration tunes the animation speed.

skeleton.animations-desc: Pulse fades, wave shimmers (right-to-left under RTL), none stays static.

composition.note: Reusable loading presets composed from skeleton primitives. Each demo is wrapped in an aria-busy region.

skeleton.description: Non-interactive loading placeholder component for content in a loading state.

examples.note: Text, rectangular, and circular placeholders. The snippet shows the minimal template.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris UI package and import the skeleton component.

multiline.note: Multi-line text uses deterministic widths with a shorter last line. The snippet reflects the current selection.

props.note: Full props reference lives in the component documentation.

size-density.note: Every size × density × variant cell is an explicit rule on its own px scale. The snippet reflects the current selection.

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.variants-desc: Text lines, rectangular blocks, and circular avatars.
